answer: A whisper carries no weight unless a stranger repeats it, so testimony must be independent. Each identity needs two holders outside its own reef to countersign its claim, and one countersignature backs one identity, so n aliases need n separate witnesses instead of a single ring. Every claim is priced by rank: the k-th filing costs k squared in bond, so a farm pays near n cubed while still requiring unrelated guarantors. A nebula audit replays a random claim each epoch, and an unconfirmed claim forfeits its bond.
